top_signals.title: Tech Stocks Slide as Nvidia, Anthropic Tests Await: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A selloff in technology stocks carried into a new week as traders shied away from risk with the fallout from Nvidia Corp.’s leadership crisis still playing out and Anthropic PBC nearing its high-stakes market debut.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: City of Osaka warns of data breach impacting 1 million as Japan reels from dozens of cyber incidents
top_signals.summary: Osaka, Japan's third-largest city, told its 2.8 million residents to be wary of suspicious emails purporting to come from the local government.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Structural Shift in Bonds Creates Income Opportunity, Barclays Says
top_signals.summary: Michel Vernier, fixed income strategist at Barclays, says the structural shift in bond markets means investors need to get used to higher yields and more volatility. "In that environment, it's actually quite good to earn income," Vernier tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Hydropower generation in the Southwest fell to record lows this summer
top_signals.summary: Prolonged drought conditions affecting the Colorado River Basin led to record low hydropower generation this summer in the Southwestern electricity supply region, which includes Arizona, New Mexico, and small parts of Nevada and California. Hydropower generation from April through August 2026 was 19% lower than during the same period last year and 28% lower than the 10-year average, according to the latest data from our Form EIA-923 survey
